transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Well, I guess what brings me in is that... I just don't feel real happiness or closeness anymore. It's been tough. Even when my wife tries to get me to enjoy our old Sunday routines, or if something at work goes really well and I should be happy... I just don't feel anything. I can't seem to enjoy it at all.
How long have you been feeling this way?
Well, it's been going on since the retrofit accident. So... that would be about a year and seven months ago now. Yeah, right around then is when it all started.
Have you had any periods in the last year and seven months where you felt extremely down or depressed?

No, not really. I mean, I wouldn't say I've felt extremely down or depressed. It's more just... empty, I guess. Like I said, I just don't feel much of anything. But I haven't had any periods where I couldn't get out of bed because I was so sad, or anything like that. Just this constant numbness.
Have you lost interest in activities that you used to enjoy?

I don't think I've lost interest, exactly. I mean... I still do them. I haven't stopped doing the things I used to like. I still go through the motions with my wife on the weekends, and I keep up with my normal routines. It's just that, like I said, I don't get any enjoyment out of it anymore. So I guess the interest to do them is still there, but the actual feeling just isn't.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your weight over the past year and seven months?
No, not really. My weight has stayed pretty much the same. I mean, maybe a pound or two here and there, but nothing significant. My clothes all still fit the same as they did before.
Do you feel sad most of the time?
No, I wouldn't say I feel sad. It's... it's not sadness. Like I was saying before, it's really just that numbness. I don't feel sad, I just don't feel much at all.
Do you still look forward to things that are coming up?

No, not really. I don't think I look forward to much of anything right now. Like I said about feeling numb, I just kind of get through the week. There isn't really anything on the calendar that makes me feel excited or... or eager for it to happen. I just take it one day at a time.
Are there any activities that you still enjoy or find pleasure in?

Not really, no. Honestly, that's a big part of what brings me in. I just don't feel real happiness or... closeness anymore. Even when my wife tries to get me to enjoy our old Sunday routines, or if something at work goes really well, I just don't feel anything from it. I can't seem to find pleasure in any of it.
Do you feel like you're unable to experience pleasure from activities that normally would bring you pleasure?

Yeah, like I was just saying, that's exactly it. That's really the main thing that brought me in to see you. I just can't seem to feel any real happiness or closeness to anyone. Like I mentioned with my wife trying to get us back into our old Sunday routines, or even if a project at work goes perfectly... I just don't get any good feelings from it anymore. I'm just completely unable to enjoy those things now.
Do you ever feel depressed?

No, I wouldn't say I feel depressed. It's not a sad feeling, really. It's more just... empty. I don't feel down in the dumps or like crying or anything like that. It's just that lack of feeling I was talking about.
Have you had any thoughts of death or suicidal thoughts over the past year and seven months?

No, I haven't. Nothing like that. I don't have any thoughts about wanting to die or... hurting myself or anything. Like I said, it's really just that empty feeling, but I definitely don't want to end my life.
Do you feel like your lack of interest in activities is mild or has it significantly impacted your daily life?

It's definitely had a significant impact. It's not mild at all. At work, I've actually had to hand off floor responsibilities that I always used to manage myself. And... well, I had an interview for a regional director position, and I just lost my composure completely. It was bad enough that I actually just walked out of the room. And at home, it's taking a toll on my marriage. It feels really strained because, like I said, I'm there physically, but I'm not really participating in our life together.
Would you say that your empty feeling is mild, moderate, or severe?

I would say it's severe. It's really the main reason I'm here. I just... I don't feel real happiness or closeness anymore. Even when things go well at work, or when my wife tries to get me to enjoy our old Sunday routines... I just feel nothing. It's completely flat.
Do you ever feel a sad or depressed mood?
No, not really. It's not sadness, exactly. I don't feel down or... depressed in that way. It's more just what I was saying before—just a total lack of feeling. It's not sad, it's just empty.
Are you unable to experience pleasure from almost all activities most of the time?

Yeah, I'd say so. Like I was just saying, I don't really get any enjoyment out of things anymore. Whether it's at work or trying to do things at home with my wife... I just don't feel that happiness or pleasure. It's just that same empty feeling all the time.
How long have you felt like you couldn't enjoy the things you used to like?
It's been going on since the retrofit accident. That was... about a year and seven months ago. Ever since then, really.
Do you ever feel a depressed mood, even if it's just for a short time?
No, I really don't. Like I was saying a minute ago, it's not a sad feeling for me. Not even for a little bit. I just... I don't feel down, I just feel blank.
Have you had a period of two weeks or more where you felt depressed?
No, not at all. Like I was just saying, I don't really get that sad or depressed feeling. So, no, definitely not for two weeks. It's really just... just that blankness I mentioned.
Do you feel hopeless about the future?

No, I wouldn't say hopeless. I mean... I don't really sit around thinking things are doomed or that life is over, or anything like that. It's not a dark feeling. It's just, well, like I said before, I just don't feel much of anything about it either way.
Do you ever feel a depressed mood?
I think you might have just asked me that. But no, I don't. Like I was saying, I don't get a depressed or sad mood, it's really just that blank feeling.
